rows.title: Restart does not revive stale handles
rows.evidence: records reconciled; no handle API exists

step.title: recovery on Host B
step.taskError: Host process restarted; this adapter cannot reattach its old pipes. Previous PID retained for diagnosis. Its provider processes ran in a Bunny-owned Windows job that the kernel ends when the previous Host's handles close; this Host verifies the recorded process identities (provider_session events) and killed no process.

providerSessionEvents.detail: Host restarted while a claude session ran in a Bunny-owned Windows job (operation d5e9b713-5d7d-468c-a6ed-7e90bf7673f8, generation a2f8df6a-4ce6-41e7-85fa-5172c9eb4154); the kernel ends job members when the last job handle closes. Verifying recorded process identities before this counts as stopped.

Interrupted provider session d5e9b713-5d7d-468c-a6ed-7e90bf7673f8: none of its 38 recorded process identities appears in an independent process-table read (kernel accounting does not exist after the job died with the previous Host; recorded as absent_after_restart, not kernel-verified empty). No process was killed by this Host.
